# Canon Data Directory Guide

This folder intentionally contains a mix of canon source files and generated outputs.
To keep it manageable, treat files by role:

## Source of truth (edit by hand)

- `source-canon-v1.json`
- `source-canon-v1.manual-curation.json`
- `source-canon-v1.supplemental-source-rows.json`
- `founder-priority-aliases-v1.json`
- `source-canon-v1.proxy-concerns.md`
- `source-canon-v1.profile-concerns.md`

## Generated by scripts (do not hand-edit)

- `source-canon-v1.flat.json`
- `source-canon-v1.source-audit.json`
- `source-canon-v1.curation-candidates.json`
- `source-canon-v1.match-audit.json`
- `source-canon-v1.reseed-preview.json`
- `source-canon-v1.provenance.json`
- `source-canon-v1.post-cutover-audit.json`
- `source-canon-v1.vitamin-coverage-fix-report.json`
- `source-canon-v1.micronutrient-*`

## Regeneration commands

- `npm run canon:build`
- `npm run canon:curate:build`
- `npm run canon:reseed:dry`
- `npm run canon:provenance:build`
- `npm run canon:matrix:build`

## Cleanup note

Scratch research/unresolved files should not be committed in this folder.
Use a local scratch location (or a dedicated ignored subfolder) for one-off investigations.
